metadata.description: Partial-absent ground truth set: multi-sub-part questions where at least one sub-part is genuinely absent from the corpus

items.question: What are Waymo's reported safety metrics (injury rates, crash statistics) for its Rider-Only services, and what specific details does the research provide about the Waymo taxi service expansion strategy?

sub_parts.text: Waymo's reported safety metrics (injury rates, crash statistics) for Rider-Only services across all locations

gold_ref.excerpt: When considering all locations together, the any-injury-reported crashed vehicle rate was 0.6 incidents per million miles (IPMM) for the ADS vs 2.80 IPMM for the human benchmark, an 80% reduction or a human crash rate that is 5 times higher than the ADS rate.

sub_parts.text: Specific details about Waymo taxi service expansion strategy, commercial rollout timeline, or deployment to new markets

absence_probe_log.verdict: Genuinely absent: zero hits across four distinct lexical probes (taxi/commercial/expansion/deployment) over 46,155 chunks. The corpus focuses on safety studies and technical performance, not commercial roadmaps.
